workflow.assignee_help: Group or role name, or user name (name or name@provider).
workflow.cancel_confirm: Cancel this case? It is closed and stays in the history.
workflow.description_help: Shown above the form. Blank lines separate paragraphs.
workflow.err_action: Step "{step}": every action needs a button text and a next step.
workflow.err_field_label: Every form field needs a label.
workflow.err_steps: A workflow needs at least one step.
workflow.fields_help: Fields the person fills in when starting a case (e.g. an application form).
workflow.final_help: End state: the case is closed when it reaches this step.
workflow.label: Label
workflow.login: Sign in to start a case
workflow.start_help: After submitting, the case goes to the first step: {step}.
workflow.started_none: You have not started any cases.
workflow.steps_help: The case starts in the first step. Each action leads to a next step; steps without actions end the case.
workflow.template_confirm: Replace the current process with the template?
workflow.approval_help: The case continues when enough people have approved. A single rejection ends the approval.
workflow.condition_help: Checks the details of the start form automatically and continues accordingly (e.g. different interviewers per position).
workflow.delay_help: Waits a fixed time or until a date from the form (e.g. the start date) and then continues automatically.
workflow.due_days_help: Reminds the people responsible by e-mail if nothing happened. 0 = no reminder.
workflow.email_help: Sends an e-mail automatically and continues. All fields may contain placeholders such as {{field.email}} or {{actor.name}}.
workflow.email_to_help: Addresses, {{field.email}}, starter, actor, user:name, group:name or role:name, separated by commas.
workflow.email_from_help: Optional. Only addresses allowed by the administrator are used as sender, others as reply-to address.
workflow.err_email: Step "{step}": recipient, subject and text are required.
workflow.err_rules: Step "{step}": every rule needs a field.
workflow.mail_not_configured: No mail server is configured yet; e-mails are kept until an administrator sets one up.
workflow.next_error_help: Optional; without it, the case waits for a manager to retry or skip.
workflow.placeholders_help: Click a placeholder to insert it into the last field you were in.
workflow.required_approvals_help: 0 = everyone in the group or role
workflow.webhook_help: Sends the case as JSON to another system (e.g. HR software) and continues when it answers with success. Three attempts.
workflow.webhook_no_allow: Webhooks only work for addresses an administrator allowed in config.yaml (plugins.macros.http_allow).
workflow.webhook_secret_help: Signs the request: header X-Ewiki-Signature: sha256=…
workflow.template.onboarding: Onboarding (with waiting time and welcome e-mail)
perm.workflow.process.create_help: Create workflows and change or delete your own ones (with their steps and assignees).
perm.workflow.process.admin_help: Change and delete all workflows of the category. Every change is logged in detail and the creator is notified.
perm.workflow.process.cases_help: See all cases of the workflows, cancel them and decide about failed steps. Who carries out a step is defined only by its assignee.
